rules.description: Strictly enforce historical deletion average threshold of 0.1%
Ensure zero MCF lint errors in generated output
Verify MaxDate is within allowable 3-year publication lag for active CRDC Algebra 1 StatVars

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats WHERE NOT regexp_matches(StatVar, '_SchoolGrade[78]_')
params.condition: CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 3) AND total_svs >= 120

rules.description: Verify MaxDate is at least 2021 for historical single-grade (Grade 7 and Grade 8) CRDC Algebra 1 StatVars

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats WHERE regexp_matches(StatVar, '_SchoolGrade[78]_')
